O.outcome_detail: emphasis on activities related to individual knowledge acquisition

cells.quote: As our analysis reveals, collaboration scripts for face-to-face learning often focus on supporting collaborators in engaging in activities that are specifically related to individual knowledge acquisition.
cells.note: Conceptual comparison; the text reports a difference in emphasis rather than an experimental effect.

O.outcome_detail: facilitation of communicative-coordinative processes among group members
